title: [29.X]-Serial numbers selected on Assembly Order component lines are deleted when running Calculate Regenerative Plan, without carrying out action messages.
summary: Serial number tracking on assembly order component lines is now preserved when running the Calculate Regenerative Plan action instead of being unexpectedly deleted without processing corresponding action messages.
key_points: Serial numbers selected on assembly order component lines are no longer deleted during Calculate Regenerative Plan execution
Assembly line inventory profile codeunit updated to handle serial number retention
New test coverage added for assembly item tracking scenarios
Fixes behavior where action messages were not generated despite deletion of serial numbers
